Was recommended by my baby's dermatologist for her atopic dermatitis and eczema. No lotion could help, they would only aggravate the irritation on her sensitive skin. This one has a very simple and basic formula that goes smooth on my baby's skin, protects and hydrates well. Glad i found it.

Best ever cream for mild eczema. My 6yr old had patches of eczema since birth, that slowly extended on his whole body even his cheeks. We saw dermatologist and GP's, used steroid creams and all sort of oat baths, it didn't work, until 4 years ago while we were abroad a pharmacist recommended this cream to me and we've noticed a difference from the first use. In 2 months of using it twice a day his eczema was completely gone. Then we started using it less and less and the eczema rarely comes back. It keeps his skin moisturised and the eczema under control. We allways have it at home now and taken it with us when we go away. I honestly recommended this cream it truly worked for our son.
